ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within circle $\odot O$, through the midpoint $C$ of radius $OD$, construct $AB\perp OD$ intersecting $\odot O$ at points $A$ and $B$, and $AB=2\sqrt{3}$. What is the area of the shaded region?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\[
\textbf{Solution:} \text{The area of the shaded part} = S_{\text{sector } BOD} - S_{\triangle COB} = \frac{60^\circ \times \pi \times 2^2}{360^\circ} - \frac{1}{2} \times \sqrt{3} \times 1 = \boxed{\frac{2}{3} \pi - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}.
\]

The shaded area equals the area of sector BOD minus the area of right triangle COB, namely (60/360)π·2^2 − (1/2)·1·√3 = 2π/3 − √3/2.
